column2: The number of Go-opsin genes varies within the genus: there is one gene in E. marginata, E. timida and E. leucolegnote, two in E. crispata and E. papillosa, and three loci in the assemblies of E. chlorotica and E. atroviridis. Go-opsin 1 of E. crispata has a one-to-one orthologue only in E. chlorotica, its closest relative among these species; in a preliminary gene tree the other sequences do not separate into two clear groups.
The number of Go-opsin genes varies within the genus (one to three per assembly), so one-to-one orthologues cannot always be assigned; see Go-opsin 1.

The full-length protein, known from annotated genes in E. chlorotica, E. marginata and other gastropods, is about 550 to 660 residues long. The E. crispata model (249 residues) and the models derived from it by alignment cover only the conserved core, so "partial" here refers to the gene model and not to the gene.
